AMBA Trading Company
 --Appellant
 Versus
Kushwaha Electricals
 --Respondent
Hon'ble Ashish Naithani, J.,
 Mr. Rohit Arora, learned counsel for the Appellant.
2. Mr. D.N. Sharma, learned counsel for the Respondent. 
3. The matter is listed for disposal of the Delay Condonation 
Application (IA No. 01 of 2024).
4. Heard learned counsel for the parties on the Delay 
Condonation Application. 
5. Learned counsel for the Appellant, however, explains the 
delay as stated in the application filed before this Court. The 
delay of 3 days is well explained; therefore, the same is hereby 
condoned. Accordingly, the Delay Condonation Application is 
allowed.
6. The present Application has been filed by the Complainant 
seeking Special Leave to Appeal against the judgment and order 
dated 09.09.2024, passed by the learned Additional Chief Judicial 
Magistrate/IInd Additional Civil Judge (Senior Divison), 
Rudrapur, District Udham Singh Nagar, whereby the accused has 
been acquitted of the offence under Section 138 of the Negotiable 
Instruments Act, 1881.
7. After hearing learned counsel for the parties, this matter 
requires consideration.
8. Let the Trial Court’s Record be summoned.
9. Upon receipt of the Trial Court’s Record, the Registry is 
directed to prepare the paper book and furnish the same to the  concerned parties, as per Rules.
10. Objections, if any, be filed by the Respondent.
11. List this case on 25.03.2026.
(Hon'ble Ashish Naithani, J.)
 16-02-2026
 
Shiksha
